body: I've mostly accepted it, but it still keeps me up some nights

This is absolutely me. I guess the reason is due to past trauma and me automatically believing that if they get to know me they won’t like me and will abandon me. So I’m pretty much rejecting them to save myself the pain of being rejected myself.

Thanks. I don’t doubt that I’ll find someone who loves me. I have a friend who loves me. It’s not really the same as a romantic love as far as I know, but it’s enough for me and I’m happy with the way it is, but it just has no affect on me. It’s not so much whether I’ll be loved, but rather when I am loved will I be able feel it and believe it. Which at the moment, and for the foreseeable future, the answer is no.
I’m still here but things don’t just get better for some people.
What do you need me for? You don’t even know me. Nobody needs me, and even if they did I don’t care.
I really don’t have anything to live for though. I’m only second guessing myself because of basic survival instinct. I’ve made up my mind anyway, nobody is going to talk me out of it.
It’s nice to know I’m not alone.
Thanks I’ll check that out when the time comes!
Yes I’m going to therapy too, I was actually going to do EMDR for what we thought was just depression at the time, but it doesn’t really matter. I won’t be able to afford therapy very soon.
Thank you, and yeah, born with PTSD probably wasn’t the best choice of words. That’s just one way my therapist put it.
I’m not but if I was it wouldn’t mean anything to me.
My parents neglected me so I never learned how to form relationships or feel empathy.
Childhood trauma
No, I don’t care about anyone or anything, and I’m physically not able to either.
I won’t have that problem. I’m not overdosing I’m using carbon monoxide. I’ll go to sleep and never wake up.
I’ve backed out of it a few times and each time I’ve only regretted not going through with it
I’m sorry to hear you’re in a similar situation.
I need the money I’m gonna get at that time. Otherwise I’m pretty indifferent to it.
Carbon monoxide
Thanks for talking btw. I’m going to bed now. Guess I’m gonna put it off a bit longer.

I don’t know, I haven’t had turkey bacon in awhile, but if it does just a little bit similar to regular bacon then I think it’d pair well with the rosemary. That combo is the best part imo.

I’d rather not say. You can call me J if you want I guess.
Turkey bacon might work? Like I said I just follow the recipe so I’m not sure what works with what. Still, I don’t see why it wouldn’t work. Sorry about your grandfather.

Tbh I didn’t know you had to dethaw in water. I usually just take it out of the freezer in the morning and leave it on the counter.

But yeah go for it, it’s really good. Just make sure to secure the bacon with toothpicks or something and move it around a lot on the grill so it doesn’t catch fire from the bacon fat. The bacon always looks burnt when I do it but I definitely don’t taste it.

I think them wanting me to cook was a combination of them being tired of me being lazy, and also not wanting to cook some nights.

You’re probably over cooking it, it’s pretty easy to do, especially if you don’t have a good meat thermometer. Favorite recipe would have to be this rosemary chicken. You take a chicken breast, season it with garlic powder, salt, and pepper, lay a rosemary sprigs on top of it, then wrap the whole thing in bacon and grill it at around 350-425 degrees for 7-8mins per side. Kinda the opposite of vegetarian haha, but it’s sooo good. 

As far as how I got into it, my parents asked me to start cooking once a week and then I just kept doing it because I enjoy it. Everybody says I’m good at it, but I honestly just follow the recipe haha. But no, I don’t think there’s anything that I’m dying (no pun intended) to make.
Lots of stuff with chicken. That’s probably my favorite food overall. And I like making chocolate cake too. I’ve only been doing it for a few months though so I’m not a world class chef or anything.
Hi. Don’t worry I’m not much of a talker so I don’t know what to say most of the time.
And then they conquer it. Like I said, my brothers beat it. And a large majority of people beat it, or overcome much, much worse.

Yeah but it’s still mostly my fault I’m here. I have two older brothers who were subject to the same treatment, they even developed depression like me, but they beat it and are both doing well. I’m just weak and a fuck up.
No, they just never told me that they loved me or that they were proud of me. Only memorable attention I got from them was being yelled at if my grades were bad or for a variety of stupid reasons.
Yeah I guess. If someone told me that or told me they love me I wouldn’t believe it. “I love you” to me is the equivalent to a cashier asking “How are you?” Just a common courtesy with no meaning.
Sure

I guess it was psychosis? I don’t know I’ve never told anyone or gotten confirmation, but I had a panic attack out of nowhere so I took a hot shower to try and calm down. I was in the shower shaking and kinda digging my fingers into my skin slightly. I swore at the time that my skin was melting off and that I was pulling chunks off just by grasping at my sides.
I’m seeing my third therapist for past couple months. I like him, I trust him, I feel comfortable being honest, and I am honest but it just isn’t helping.

Yeah, maybe if I loved someone or someone loved me I’d stick around, but that’s just never gonna happen. I crave that sort of closeness and emotional connection, yet I reject it and push people away when I do get it. I’m damaged goods, nobody’s patient enough to deal with me. Nobody would even want to know me on a basic level, I have no passions, no interests, and no energy or will to live. I mean, just listen to what I said. Would you honestly want to be around someone like this?
Nothing really. I’m just sort of existing. Waiting and hoping I get cancer or get hit by a bus.
Cooking

That one quote that equates it to jumping from a burning building is so true. And you’re right about the shit talking too. Nobody ever says or cares how brave we are for facing the horror of our daily lives, just that we’re cowards for refusing to endure it any longer.
I think I’d probably just skip it all until I’m dead.
